explanation: Ran ./eta/build/exclurad with eta/input.dat, which was already configured exactly for the requested kinematics (model=3 EtaMAID, rc_mode=0 full O(alpha), bmom=6.53 GeV CLAS12 beam momentum, ivec=1 detected recoil proton, vcut=0.166 GeV^2 standard CLAS12 inelasticity cut, W=1.5753 GeV, Q2=0.3 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=-0.527586, phi*=36/72/108 deg). W=1.5753 GeV is above the eta-production threshold (m_p+m_eta=1.4861 GeV), so the kinematics are physical. delta (=sigma_obs/sigma_Born, column 6) and sigma_Born (column 7, code-internal units of the Born five-fold cross section) were read directly from eta/radtot.dat without rounding.
